name: G7 T3 W09 Part 2 - Find your saved files
description: Find your saved files. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: A saved piece of work on a computer.
words.example: I save my spreadsheet as a file named ClubResults.xlsx.

words.definition: A place on a computer for keeping files together.
words.example: The folder keeps my three project files together.
